escena: SCENE (Efeonce meeting room, Santiago, late afternoon, minutes after the session ended): on the table, still where it was put down, a large printed sheet covered in dense printed lines too small and too steeply angled to be read, one of its rows left completely blank. Standing upright on the table right beside that sheet, the small Codex figure from the reference is the ONLY presence left in the room, turned towards the sheet. A laptop lies closed and dark; a single monitor at the far end of the table is asleep, showing only a small steady blue light. Hard low afternoon sun from a window on the left rakes across the table and the sheet, and stays BELOW the middle of the frame: it never reaches the wall above. Behind and above the table the plaster wall is one smooth unbroken surface in deep shadow, with nothing on it and no window, no lamp and no bright spot anywhere in it. 50mm lens at f/2.8.

texto.muro: the smooth plaster meeting-room wall above the table

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the meeting table in the immediate foreground, running unbroken across the whole width of the frame
lecho.tono: DARK near-black oak in deep shadow, matte, its grain still faintly visible, outside the light
